invariants.rationale: The method always returns the 'images' array, which is newly created and never set to null, so result cannot be null.
Array<FileHandle>.size is always non-negative, as no elements are removed from the array and elements are only added.
The method requires 'root' to call getChildByName and assumes it is non-null to function without exception.
tideFile is used to construct FileHandle objects for images, so it must not be null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
Each 'TileSheet' child in the XML yields one FileHandle in the output array, establishing this size relationship.
